changes.topology_sampling: cyclic without replacement within each class
changes.loss: class-macro full 372-way T-squared KL; no hard generated labels; teacher detached

findings: Deterministic same-model self-replay has nearly zero gradient and carries no new human-label knowledge.
Dropout-on self-replay, original-to-view consistency, and Top-5 truncation produce different nonzero gradients. This does not prove accuracy gain.
Original-to-view consistency and Top-5 truncation gradients have cosine -0.4741 on this fixed class-balanced TRAIN probe; they cannot be treated as equivalent objectives.
Three geometry-valid transformations lose the original dataset label from the teacher Top-5; keep them for blind review, not hard-label training.
FP64 independent reductions reproduce all losses and the sum of all 57 parameter gradient norms.
next_required_evidence: Independent human vote distributions and unused whole-math writer/device acceptance; this microscope supplies neither.
